title: Extend an interface: Story extends Issue
statement:
Є базовий `Issue` (`id: number`, `title: string`).

1. Створи `export interface Story extends Issue` з полями `points: number` і `acceptanceCriteria: string[]`.
2. Напиши `storyLine(story)`:

```text
US-<id>: <title> — <points> pts, <кількість критеріїв> AC
```

```ts
storyLine({ id: 5, title: 'Pay with PayPal', points: 8, acceptanceCriteria: ['Button shown', 'Redirect works'] });
// 'US-5: Pay with PayPal — 8 pts, 2 AC'
```
